nodes.name: Fetch Launch Record
nodes.notes: Launch row contract (ruled 2026-09-08): Client, Table (must be "Companies", by name, no default), View (by name, required, no default), Tag. Launch Params refuses anything else before a paid call.

nodes.name: Stamp Running
nodes.notes: First thing the launch door does, ahead of every guard: the row carries the Execution ID and link from the moment the POST lands, so a refusal or a crash can always be read back on the row the Operator launched. It passes the record through, so Resolve Base still reads fields.Client off it.

nodes.name: Sub Trigger
nodes.notes: Event entry: one item carrying the same keys as a launch row (Client, View, Tag, and Domains for the insert doors). This is how an insert door calls this machine after landing: View "Not Sourced", Domains = what it landed. No launch row, no Running stamp; the first provider close creates the run row on Execution ID.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Event-Row.js

nodes.name: Resolve Base
nodes.notes: A launch row with no Client link used to kill the run right here: $json.fields.Client[0] threw inside the node before Launch Params could name the refusal, so the row got nothing back. It now asks for "recMISSING" and keeps going; Launch Params reads the answer defensively and refuses with the reason.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Launch-Params.js

nodes.name: Launch OK?
nodes.notes: The refusal gate. Launch Params names a bad launch row instead of throwing; false here means refused, and Build Refusal closes the row as Failed with the reason before anything is read or paid for.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Find-Tables.js

nodes.name: Read Companies View
nodes.notes: The Companies view (by name, required on the launch row) is the whole scope: every company in it is asked, no cap. A view that does not exist crashes here, before any paid call, into the Error Logger.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Pick-Companies.js

nodes.name: Get DNC Domains
nodes.notes: The client's table named DNC (resolved by name in Find Tables), read once for every lane. No DNC table: the read errors quietly and nothing is dropped.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Plan-Companies.js

nodes.name: Plan Companies
nodes.notes: Cap and floor per company from the Employees value on our row, plus the DNC list: the one plan every lane receives.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Stamp-Rows.js

nodes.name: Stamp Companies
nodes.notes: The one Companies writer: Contacts Pulled At = now on every company of the run, PATCH by record id, ten per request, 200 ms apart, no retry; a request that is not 2xx counts its ten as stamp errors.

nodes.name: AT List Views
nodes.notes: After the loop closed and the companies were stamped: read the base meta again; the email door fires once if People carries a view named exactly "Not Waterfalled".

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Find-Waterfall-View.js

nodes.name: Fire Waterfall
nodes.notes: The one email hand-off, once per run after the last lane: Enrich Emails record door, People view Not Waterfalled. Not awaited; it writes its own rows.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Build-Log.js
@@file:nodes/Build-Refusal.js

nodes.name: Build Refusal
nodes.notes: A badly filled launch row closes here as Failed with the named reason and the execution link, on the same row Stamp Running opened. Refusals are expected outcomes and are logged as such; the Error Logger still owns real crashes.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Make-Chunks.js

nodes.name: Make Chunks
nodes.notes: Every chunk of the run, one flat list in provider priority order; the per-provider accumulators start here.

nodes.name: Chunk Loop
nodes.notes: One chunk at a time, one execution each (Enrich Contacts Chunk). Done output: stamp, hand-off, log.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Chunk-Input.js

nodes.name: Call Chunk
nodes.notes: Awaited. One execution per chunk; a crash comes back as an error item and is counted, the loop moves on.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Chunk-Tick.js

nodes.name: Lane Closed?
nodes.notes: True after a provider's last chunk: the launch row is refreshed before the next provider starts.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Lane-Progress.js

nodes.name: Stamp Progress
nodes.notes: The launch row refreshed after each provider closed: Status Running, the running funnel, Tally; on Execution ID (created here on an event run).

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Check-Columns.js

nodes.name: Check Columns
nodes.notes: The eleven profile columns Enrich Contacts brings to People (Headline, About, Role Description, Role Start Date, Person City, Person Country, Education, Skills, Languages, Prior Employer, Prior Title): missing ones are planned for creation, a column held at a foreign type refuses the launch on the row. Nothing is retyped or renamed.

nodes.name: Columns OK?
nodes.notes: False means a profile column is held at a foreign type; Build Refusal closes the row before anything is read or paid for.

nodes.name: Any Columns?
nodes.notes: Nothing to create: straight to the companies read.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Plan-Columns.js

nodes.name: Plan Columns
nodes.notes: One meta-API create per missing profile column.

nodes.name: Create Columns
nodes.notes: The profile columns People lacks, created on first use through the meta API, one call per column at 300 ms.

nodes.name: Reread Meta
nodes.notes: The base meta again, after the creates: verify by values, never by a success response.

parameters.jsCode: @@file:nodes/Verify-Columns.js

nodes.name: Verify Columns
nodes.notes: Every planned column must now show on People, or the run stops by name before a company is read.

writeReasons: People writer: The connection was aborted, perhaps the server is offline
